Year-only and full-date strings can have different granularity but may describe the same event. Positive subject-relation-object assignments are support, not counterevidence. For every date check birth versus death versus award/publication; for every artist check performer versus author/producer/chart. Multiple allowed entities may have separate answers. Use wrong_argument only for an explicit different role/type, not an unfamiliar value or alternate valid referent. Do not treat candidate inventory as an answer key.
